title: Neon Dreams
description: An homage to midnight drives and internet culture.
lyrics: We chase the glitching skyline after midnight
Dashboard lit like old arcades in bloom
You quote a meme from twenty-nineteen
We laugh like this rerun is brand new
Autotune prayers through a neon stream
Hoping the algorithm lets us in

title: Coffee & Code
description: Lo-fi reflections on building products with friends.
lyrics: Mugs and monitors on Monday dawn
Stack traces hum a familiar song
We ship a hotfix from the subway car
Commit emojis chart how tired we are

title: Madrugada en Madrid
description: A gentle synthwave postcard from a sleepless city night.
lyrics: El metro canta historias de papel
